subject: storytime
title: Pete the Cat words
about: Pete the cat walks along in his brand-new white shoes and keeps on singing no matter what he steps in or what color they turn. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, with him reading the color words.

book.author: Eric Litwin and James Dean
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A cool cat, a new pair of shoes and a song that does not stop for strawberries or mud.

passage.text:
Pete cat shoes white
red blue brown wet
mud bucket water walk
cool step keep love
my new

cards.note: capital P, it is his name; magic e makes the first e say its name
sh is one part; oe says oo here and the s says z: shooz
wh says w; magic e makes i say its name
b-l blend, then ue says oo
b-r blend; ow says ou as in out, like in cow
two parts: buck + et; ck is one sound
a says aw here, like in walk: waw-ter
a says aw and the l makes no sound, like in talk: wawk
oo says long oo, like moon
o says u; ve says v: luv
ew says oo, with a little y: nyoo or noo, both are right
